drugDatabase.name: Amoxicillin
drugDatabase.indications: Bacterial infections of ear, nose, throat, skin, and urinary tract.
drugDatabase.dosage: 500 mg every 8 hours or 875 mg every 12 hours orally.
drugDatabase.mechanism: Inhibits bacterial cell wall synthesis by binding to penicillin-binding proteins.
drugDatabase.contraindications: History of severe hypersensitivity to penicillins or cephalosporins.

drugDatabase.name: Metformin HCl
drugDatabase.dosage: 500 mg to 1000 mg twice daily with meals (Max: 2550 mg/day).
drugDatabase.mechanism: Decreases hepatic glucose production and increases peripheral insulin sensitivity.
drugDatabase.contraindications: Severe renal impairment (eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73m²), acute metabolic acidosis.

drugDatabase.name: Lisinopril
drugDatabase.mechanism: Inhibits Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme, reducing angiotensin II and aldosterone production.
drugDatabase.contraindications: History of ACE inhibitor-induced angioedema, pregnancy.

drugDatabase.name: Atorvastatin Calcium
drugDatabase.indications: Hypercholesterolemia, Primary and secondary cardiovascular risk reduction.
drugDatabase.dosage: 10 mg to 80 mg once daily at bedtime.
drugDatabase.mechanism: Reversibly inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, reducing hepatic cholesterol synthesis.
drugDatabase.contraindications: Active liver disease, unexplained persistent elevation of hepatic transaminases.

drugDatabase.name: Ibuprofen
drugDatabase.indications: Mild to moderate pain, inflammation, fever reduction.
drugDatabase.dosage: 200 mg to 400 mg every 4-6 hours PRN.
drugDatabase.contraindications: Active peptic ulcer, severe renal failure.

drugDatabase.name: Warfarin Sodium
drugDatabase.indications: Venous thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, atrial fibrillation.
drugDatabase.dosage: Adjusted individually based on target INR (2.0 - 3.0).

drugDatabase.name: Aspirin
drugDatabase.indications: Ischemic stroke prophylaxis, acute coronary syndrome.
drugDatabase.dosage: 81 mg daily (cardioprotective) or 325 mg during acute events.
drugDatabase.mechanism: Irreversibly acetylates COX-1, preventing thromboxane A2 formation.
drugDatabase.contraindications: Bleeding disorders, Reye syndrome in children.

drugInteractionMatrix.title: Major Hemorrhagic Risk
drugInteractionMatrix.description: Synergistic antiplatelet and anticoagulant effect dramatically increases risk of major bleeding.
drugInteractionMatrix.action: Avoid concomitant combination unless strictly indicated. Monitor INR closely.

drugInteractionMatrix.title: Renal Impairment & Antihypertensive Blunting
drugInteractionMatrix.description: NSAIDs inhibit renal prostaglandins, reducing lisinopril efficacy and elevating kidney injury risk.
drugInteractionMatrix.action: Monitor blood pressure and serum creatinine. Recommend paracetamol as alternative.

drugInteractionMatrix.title: Increased Risk of Lactic Acidosis
drugInteractionMatrix.description: NSAID-induced renal impairment can decrease clearance of metformin.
drugInteractionMatrix.action: Ensure baseline eGFR > 45 mL/min before co-prescribing.
